title: CANON-11 — The Player
status: **APPROVED** (Marc, Nov 9, 2026: "approve canon 01–15") · Owner: Marc · Changes only through CANON-99 (CANON-00 rules 10–16)
summary: everything that happens inside the player: playback, sting and Belle, pause and resume, saving progress, series buttons, auto-continue, the "Up next" gap, the review pop-up at story end, lock-screen and car controls, skip buttons, the offline player, the eBook reader inside the player, and play logging.
body:
Status: APPROVED (Marc, Nov 9, 2026: "approve canon 01–15") · Owner: Marc · Changes only through CANON-99 (CANON-00 rules 10–16)

Covers: everything that happens inside the player: playback, sting and Belle, pause and resume, saving progress, series buttons, auto-continue, the "Up next" gap, the review pop-up at story end, lock-screen and car controls, skip buttons, the offline player, the eBook reader inside the player, and play logging. Does not cover: the Library, story cards, Rate button look, playlists as a list, sign-up, trial and paywall (CANON-12 The Listener App); how stories, Belle intros/outros and name clips are written and voiced (story pipeline canon, docs/PIPELINE-CANON.md).

Note: docs/PLAYER-RULES.md is approved canon (Marc, Nov 9). Sections A to F copy it with the same meaning. Section G adds what it misses.

Where Marc decides

Every rule in this document that needs Marc. MARC DECIDES = Marc approves, chooses or gives his OK. MARC DOES = something only Marc does himself (tests on his phone, listens, enters a key). The same tag marks each rule below.

  • Rule 37 MARC DECIDES: All episodes publish together. A series stays hidden until every episode is finished and approved, then they all go live at the same time.
  • Rule 40 MARC DECIDES: The publish switch on the Admin page decides who approves. It is checked when a story is ready to publish. On "Review", every story waits for Marc…
  • Rule 46 MARC DOES: Marc checks it on a real phone before any player change is accepted.
  • Still open: nothing. Every conflict and question below is RESOLVED (CANON-99 Parts 1 and 2, Nov 9, 2026).

Rules

A. Playback basics — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

The listener is always in control. The player never starts, restarts or jumps on its own, except auto-continue to the next episode, or to the next story in a playlist.

  1. One player. There is one canonical player for every story. No copies or test variants in the live app. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  2. Every story and every episode opens with the Endless Tales sting, right at the start of Belle's intro. Then the story, then Belle's outro. This applies to a first play, Start Over and autoplay. Resuming after a pause continues from the same spot and does not replay the sting. Nothing is skipped. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; Marc, Nov 8)
  3. Pause works everywhere: in the app, on the lock screen, car controls and headphones. Pausing never resets the position. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  4. The lock screen shows the right episode: title, series and cover art, updated whenever the episode changes. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  5. Opening or returning to the app never starts playback by itself. Only the listener's Play does. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  6. Start Over happens only when the listener taps Start Over. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  7. When a standalone story or a series finale ends, the next story starts after 2 to 3 seconds if the listener is in a playlist. Otherwise the review screen pops up, then the Library. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  8. Personalized name in Belle's intro: if the listener's name can't be added, the no-name version plays. Playback is never blocked for this. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  9. Belle's outro points forward. In every episode except the last, Belle recaps the episode in one sentence, then promotes the next episode by its number. The last episode, and a standalone story, never points to another episode; it ends with the personalization statement. There is no gap between Belle's outro and the personalization. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; Marc, Nov 8)
  10. The progress bar is honest. It sits at the far left when an episode begins and reaches the far right exactly when it ends. It never stops partway when the episode is over, including after a pause and resume. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; Marc, Nov 8)

B. Saving and resuming — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

A listener always comes back to the exact spot they left, on any device, after any interruption.

  1. Progress saves every 5 seconds while playing, and right away on pause, seek, closing the app or locking the phone. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  2. Phone calls never lose the place. If a call or the phone resets the audio to zero, the player restores the saved spot when the listener presses Play. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  3. Rewinds count. If the listener goes back on purpose, the earlier spot is saved. An older save never overwrites a newer one. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  4. Finished means finished. An episode is marked complete only when it plays to the real end, never because it was closed near the end. Once complete, it stays complete. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  5. Same account, any device. Progress follows the listener to another phone or computer. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  6. Signing in again doesn't reload the episode. A login refresh for the same listener keeps playing where it is. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  7. Offline listening follows the same rules, including rewinds and saving when the app closes. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

C. Series navigation — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

  1. Every series episode shows three buttons: Previous, Episodes and Next. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  2. Previous and Next go to the episode before or after. Previous is greyed out on Episode 1. Next is greyed out on the last episode. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  3. Episodes opens a list of the series' live episodes in order. It shows the current episode, which are finished, and the saved spot in each. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  4. Picking an unfinished episode resumes at its saved spot. Start Over stays a separate, deliberate choice. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  5. Only live episodes appear. Hidden episodes are never listed or reachable. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  6. If saved progress can't load, the list says "progress unavailable" instead of showing a wrong number. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  7. Series buttons are at least 44 pixels tall. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

D. Auto-continue: next episode and next story — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

Listening never stops between episodes. Each episode flows into the next until the story is finished. In a playlist, the next story starts after that. The gap is 2 to 3 seconds. (Marc, Nov 8)

  1. Next episode: when a series episode plays to its natural end, the next episode starts by itself after 2 to 3 seconds. This repeats until the last episode is finished. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; also memory /projects/.../areas/endless-tales-platform.md, Nov 5: "must always auto-advance… hard-wired")
  2. Next story in a playlist: when a story is finished (its last episode, or a standalone), the next story in the playlist starts after 2 to 3 seconds. No review screen pops up in a playlist. Instead the finished story's card in the Library shows the red "Rate" button until the listener reviews it. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; Marc, Nov 8)
  3. Not in a playlist: when a story is finished, the review screen pops up by itself. If the listener closes it without reviewing, the center button on that story's card turns red ("Rate") until they review it. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; Marc, Nov 8)
  4. Every new episode or story starts with its sting and Belle's intro. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  5. Only a natural end counts. Pausing, scrubbing or leaving mid-story never triggers auto-continue. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  6. No "Still listening?" prompt. The player never stops to ask whether the listener is still there. It keeps going until the story, or the playlist, is finished. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  7. The next item must be live. If the next episode or story is missing or hidden, the player goes to the Library and logs a warning. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  8. Phone locked or app in the background: auto-continue works the same way, and the lock screen updates to the new episode or story. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  9. During the 2-to-3-second gap the screen shows "Up next" and the next title, in large white text on dark, with one large Cancel button. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  10. Tapping Cancel stops the advance and goes to the Library. It applies that one time only. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  11. Pressing pause during the gap (lock screen, car or headphones) just pauses. Pressing Play then starts the next item from the beginning, with the sting and Belle's intro. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; memory player-rules.md)
  12. The finished episode is marked complete, and the next one is recorded as if the listener pressed Play. Advanced and cancelled events are logged. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

E. What listeners can see — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

  1. MARC DECIDES All episodes publish together. A series stays hidden until every episode is finished and approved, then they all go live at the same time. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; Marc, Nov 8)
  2. Episodes are numbered from 1 and count up with no gaps. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  3. Hidden episodes never show up in lists, navigation or autoplay. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  4. MARC DECIDES The publish switch on the Admin page decides who approves. It is checked when a story is ready to publish. On "Review", every story waits for Marc to listen and approve. On "Direct", stories go live without Marc's review. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  5. New episodes added to an existing series go live as one batch. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

F. Design and readability — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

  1. White text on dark backgrounds. Never grey text on dark. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  2. Orange for emphasis, such as the "Up next" label. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  3. Buttons are at least 44 pixels tall. Cancel on the "Up next" screen is at least a quarter of the screen. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  4. Nothing spills sideways on phones, tablets or computers. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  5. MARC DOES Marc checks it on a real phone before any player change is accepted. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

G. Added rules (not in docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

Controls on the player screen

  1. The Pause button is always visible on the player screen while a story plays, without scrolling. — Agreed (Marc's iPhone test Nov 6, chat "Cover story map pattern": "no pause button showing even when I scroll down"; fix handed off with Marc's go)
  2. When playback is about to start by itself (auto-continue or a Play tap from a card), the big button already reads "Pause". It never flashes "Play" for a second. — Agreed (AUTOSTART-LABEL-001, Marc Nov 6, components/player/CanonicalPlayer.tsx)
  3. There are two skip buttons: back 15 seconds and forward 15 seconds. — In force (code) (components/player/PlayerTransport.tsx)
  4. The offline player uses the same skip amounts as the online player: back 15, forward 15. — Proposed (today offline is back 15 / forward 30; one rule avoids confusion)
  5. ~~At the natural end, the big button reads "Play Again"~~ Replaced by decision 134: when the story is over there is no Play Again. "Start Over" on the player still starts from 0:00 with the sting; it never resumes from the last few seconds. — Changed (Marc, Nov 10, 2026, decision 134)
  6. ~~The "Story complete" screen always has a "Browse more stories" button~~ Retired by decision 134: there is no "Story complete" screen; a finished story goes to the Library. — Changed (Marc, Nov 10, 2026, decision 134)
  7. "Not for me" shows only before the listener has any progress and only on a standalone or Episode 1. Tapping it hides that story (all episodes of a series) and returns to the Library. — In force (code) (CanonicalPlayer.tsx handleNotForMe)
  8. "Not for me" must meet the white-text and 44-pixel rules (today it is faint grey, 12px). — Proposed (fills a gap between rule 53 and rules 42 and 44)
  9. The full player covers every page bar (Library genre bar, Continue card, playlist bar) but stays under the app header. — Agreed (PLAYER-ON-TOP-001, Marc Nov 6, components/player/PersistentPlayer.tsx)

Auto-continue details

  1. Arriving by auto-continue plays the next episode from the top (0:00, with sting), even if the listener once listened to part of it. — Agreed (AUTOADVANCE-FRESH-001, Marc Nov 6, CanonicalPlayer.tsx)
  2. On an advance, the old episode never replays, even for a second. — Agreed (HANDOFF-STALE-AUTOPLAY-001, Marc Oct 29, CanonicalPlayer.tsx)
  3. Only Cancel during the gap, or the listener choosing a different story, stops auto-continue. Pause, phone calls, screen lock, background, car and headphone controls never turn it off. — Agreed (Marc's rule sent to the player builder, chat "Cover story map pattern", Nov 7; CanonicalPlayer.tsx comment "Marc's rule: interruptions never cancel series continuation"). See Conflict C2 about "Stop".
  4. A playlist plays hands-free from first to last item, with no tap between stories, using the same audio element so phones allow it. — Agreed (MARC-PLAYLIST-HANDSFREE-001, Oct 7; MARC-PLAYLIST-AUTOADVANCE-001, Oct 5)
  5. A new playlist item starts at 0:00. Coming back to the item the playlist was already on resumes at its saved spot. — Agreed (MARC-PLAYLIST-FRESH-001, Oct 7)
  6. When an episode finishes in a playlist, it comes off the playlist and its offline copy is deleted. The rest of the playlist stays. — Agreed (QUEUE-OFFLINE-001, Marc Oct 4)
  7. When the listener reaches the end of a playlist, the player shows "Playlist finished" and a large "Back to Library" button. — Proposed (today the card says "Catalog exhausted", which listeners won't understand)

Lock screen, car and headphones

  1. Lock-screen and car controls offer Play, Pause, back 15 seconds, forward 15 seconds and drag-to-seek. — In force (code) (lib/mediaSession.ts, CAR-MEDIA-001)
  2. "Next track" on the car or headphones goes to the next episode of a series. On a standalone it skips forward 15 seconds. — In force (code) (CanonicalPlayer.tsx mediaHandlers)
  3. "Previous track" restarts the episode. Pressed in the first 5 seconds, it goes to the previous episode. — In force (code) (CanonicalPlayer.tsx mediaHandlers)
  4. The player claims the lock screen only once the listener presses Play, so opening a page never takes over another app's audio. — In force (code) (CanonicalPlayer.tsx)

Speed, sleep timer, settings

  1. The player has no speed control and no sleep timer today. Any setting shown to listeners must actually work; a control that does nothing is removed. — Proposed (Account → Settings shows Default Speed, Auto-Play Next, Skip Silence and Sleep Timer controls that save nothing and change nothing: app/account/settings/page.tsx)

Offline player

  1. Downloaded paid stories play offline only while the offline license is valid: up to 14 days since the app last checked online, and never past the subscription end (plus 3 days grace, or 0 days if cancelled). Free stories always play. — In force (code) (lib/offline/license.ts, public/offline-player.html)
  2. When the license runs out, the offline player says so in plain words and tells the listener to go online. It never fails silently. — In force (code) (public/offline-player.html)
  3. The offline player follows the auto-continue gap (2 to 3 seconds) and the sting rule like the online player. — Proposed (today it starts the next download at once; rule 17 says offline follows the same rules)

eBook reader inside the player

  1. There is one eBook reader, built into the player. "Read" on any card opens it, at the listener's saved page. Closing it returns to where the tap came from. — Agreed (Marc Oct 4 and Oct 7, UI-CARDS-EBOOK-NAV, CanonicalPlayer.tsx)
  2. eBook text size is one per-listener setting (13 to 26 points) that carries to every story. — Agreed (MARC-EBOOK-FONTSIZE-001, Oct 7)
  3. The reader shows a visible mark where the listener stopped reading. — Agreed (MARC-EBOOK-BOOKMARK-001, Oct 7)

Listener's name in Belle's intro (which clip plays)

  1. Series: the personal name greeting plays on the first episode of the series this listener plays. Later episodes use the normal Belle intro. Standalone stories keep the name in the intro. — Agreed (Marc's change sent as PR #385, chat "Clearing CEO series flag", Nov 1–2; lib/personalization/firstPlayedOpener.ts). See Conflict C4.
  2. If the name greeting is missing or fails, the normal intro plays with no gap and no error. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md rule 8; PR #385 chat)

Play logging and listen time

  1. Every play is logged in play_events, including auto-continue starts, with how it started (tap, autoplay or auto-continue) and why it stopped (finished, paused, left, app closed, error, "Not for me"). — In force (code) (lib/analytics.ts, ORION-ANALYTICS-GAP-001)
  2. Auto-continue writes three events: offered, advanced and cancelled, with story, series and episode number. — Proposed (needed to meet rule 36; the June spec named them autoplay_offered / autoplay_advanced / autoplay_cancelled; none exist in code)
  3. Logging never blocks or slows playback. — In force (code) (lib/analytics.ts header)
  4. Listening by test accounts is never counted in listener numbers. — Proposed (is_test_account exists for sales; same rule for listening)

Marc's decisions (Nov 9, 2026)

Marc answered CANON-99 on Nov 9, 2026. These decisions are Agreed and override any rule above that says otherwise. Each conflict or question below that they settle is marked RESOLVED.

  • Decision 48: Between episodes. Decided: build the 2-to-3-second "Up next" screen; one button named Cancel (one time only, goes to the Library); lock-screen Stop acts as Pause; autoplay is always on (remove the unused toggle). (11 C1, C2, Q1, Q3) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 49: Next playlist story missing or hidden. Decided: skip to the next live story; go to the Library only when none is left. This changes one Player Rule. (11 Q4) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 51: Paywall. Decided: the paywall never cuts audio mid-story; after a trial, Episode 1 of every series stays free. (11 Q5, 12 Q3, Q5) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 55: Settings page. Decided: remove the controls that don't work; no speed control or sleep timer for now. (11 Q2, 12 Q7) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 95: No review screen in a playlist (the finished story's card gets the red Rate button). Outside a playlist, after the review screen the player always goes to the Library. (11 C3, C5) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 134: When the story is over. No Play Again. A series episode that is not the last goes on to the next episode by itself, with no countdown box. In a playlist, the player goes on to the next story; when the playlist is finished, it goes to the Library. Not in a playlist, the story ends and goes to the Library (review screen first when due). Stop on a lock screen or in a car works exactly like Pause. No "Story complete", "Series complete", "Up next" countdown or "Still listening?" box. — Agreed (Marc, Nov 10, 2026, "approve 134"; code STORY-END-LIBRARY-001, CanonicalPlayer.tsx)
  • Decision 96: The name greeting plays on the first episode a listener plays; replays get the normal intro. (11 C4) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 97: The "Continue your story" mini-player stays on Home and Library only. (11 Q6) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 98: iPhone audio that gets quieter during calls is accepted for the web app and fixed in the future native app. (11 Q7) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 132: Screen-reader access in the player. The player announces what is playing and any "Up next" countdown; every pop-up is announced as a dialog with a named Close button; all of CANON-12 decision 132 applies to the player, web and native. — Agreed (Marc, Nov 10, 2026, CANON-99 item 132)

Conflicts found

  • C1. [RESOLVED by decision 48, Marc Nov 9, 2026] docs/PLAYER-RULES.md (Nov 9) says a 2-to-3-second gap with a large "Up next" screen and a Cancel button. Code: a series advances at once with no gap and no Up next screen (CanonicalPlayer.tsx startAutoAdvanceTo skips its 2.5-second timer for "next episode"); playlists and the offline player also advance at once. The June spec said 5 seconds. Recommendation: PLAYER-RULES wins (newest, Marc-approved); fix code. Marc decides.
  • C2. [RESOLVED by decision 48, Marc Nov 9, 2026] PLAYER-RULES: Cancel stops one advance only, then goes to the Library. Code: the Up next card has "Play now" and "Stop" (not "Cancel"); "Stop", and the lock-screen Stop action, turn auto-continue off for the rest of the session and stay on the player. Marc's Nov 7 rule allowed "an explicit STOP" to turn it off. Recommendation: one button named Cancel, one-time only, goes to Library; lock-screen Stop acts as Pause. Marc decides.
  • C3. [RESOLVED by decision 95, Marc Nov 9, 2026] PLAYER-RULES: no review screen in a playlist. Code shows the review pop-up whenever a final episode finishes, in any mode (saveProgress → maybeShowCompletionReviewPrompt). Recommendation: PLAYER-RULES wins; skip the pop-up in playlist mode. Marc decides. (Not yet checked on a phone.)
  • C4. [RESOLVED by decision 96, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Name greeting timing. Memory (/projects/.../areas/personalization.md and story-pipeline.md, Oct 29): "play whenever a listener starts Episode 1 from the beginning; on a later listen, warmly acknowledge the return." Nov 1–2 change (PR #385): "first episode this listener plays; replays get the normal intro." Also Oct 27–29: personalize the finale outro, but PR #385 found no personal outro exists. Recommendation: the newer Nov 1–2 rule (74) wins; the "returning listener" greeting and finale name outro stay open. Marc decides.
  • C5. [RESOLVED by decision 95, Marc Nov 9, 2026] PLAYER-RULES: not in a playlist, the review screen pops up "then the Library". Code: after the listener closes review it goes to Library, but if they already reviewed, the player stays on a "Story complete" card. Recommendation: go to the Library in both cases, keeping "Browse more stories" (rule 52) only on the card shown while the review is open. Marc decides.
  • C6. [RESOLVED: fact checked or done, Nov 9, 2026; see CANON-99 Part 2] AUTOPLAY_NEXT_EPISODE_SPEC (June) said standalones and finales never auto-advance. PLAYER-RULES (Nov 9) auto-continues to the next playlist story. PLAYER-RULES wins (already noted as replaced).

Open questions for Marc

  • Q1. [RESOLVED by decision 48, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Autoplay on/off setting for listeners, or always on with Cancel? (Open in PLAYER-RULES.) Suggested answer: always on, with Cancel. Remove the dead "Auto-Play Next" toggle in Settings.
  • Q2. [RESOLVED by decision 55, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Do listeners need a speed control (0.75x to 2x) or a sleep timer? Suggested answer: no speed control for now (drive-time); add a sleep timer later only if listeners ask, since it would stop playback by itself.
  • Q3. [RESOLVED by decision 48, Marc Nov 9, 2026] What does "Stop" on the lock screen or car do? Suggested answer: the same as Pause.
  • Q4. [RESOLVED by decision 49, Marc Nov 9, 2026] When the next playlist story is hidden or missing, should it skip to the one after, or go to the Library? PLAYER-RULES says Library. Suggested answer: skip to the next live story; go to the Library only when none is left.
  • Q5. [RESOLVED by decision 51, Marc Nov 9, 2026] A paid listener's trial ends mid-episode while driving. Does audio stop? Suggested answer: never stop mid-episode; finish the episode, then show the wall at the next start (see CANON-12 paywall).
  • Q6. [RESOLVED by decision 97, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Should the player show a sticky "Continue your story" mini-player on pages other than Home and Library? Today it shows only on those two. Suggested answer: keep as is.
  • Q7. [RESOLVED by decision 98, Marc Nov 9, 2026] iPhone audio "ducks" (gets quieter) instead of pausing when another app uses the microphone, and does not come back up (chat "QR code marketing system", Nov 3). A web app can't detect this. Suggested answer: accept for the web app; fix in the native app.

Enforcement status

  • Rules 1–6, 11–24, 63–66: enforced in code (CanonicalPlayer.tsx, EpisodeNavigation.tsx, PlayerTransport.tsx, lib/mediaSession.ts, app/api/user/save-progress). Real iPhone and Android tests still not done (PLAYER-RULES open items).
  • Rule 7, 25, 26, 33–35: NOT enforced. No 2-to-3-second gap and no Up next screen for series or playlists (see C1). Nov 8: episodes did not continue for Marc; cause not yet found.
  • Rule 9: not enforced in audio yet (Nov 8 gap before personalization, After the Last Train EP3; pipeline outro rules not updated).
  • Rule 10: not enforced (Nov 8: bar stopped at 59%, After the Last Train EP1, iPhone Safari).
  • Rule 27 (red Rate on series): NOT enforced. components/LibraryStoryCard.tsx shows Rate only when "completed"; app/library/page.tsx getCardState never sets completed or reviewed for a series.
  • Rule 30 ("Still listening?"): partly enforced. Nothing sets the prompt on any more, but its state, timer and screen are still in CanonicalPlayer.tsx (stillListeningPrompt, lines ~173, 188, 3134–3156). Remove the dead code.
  • Rule 31: partial. The player shows "Series complete"/"Catalog exhausted" with a Back to Library button and a console error; no logged warning, no automatic move.
  • Rule 34: not enforced (see C2).
  • Rule 36, 77: partial. play_events marks auto_advance starts; offered/advanced/cancelled events do not exist.
  • Rules 42–44: partly broken in the player: Up next card uses 11–13px grey text and ~38px buttons; time readout grey (#94a3b8, 12px); "Not for me" 45% white, 12px; Start Over 11px.
  • Rule 47: enforced since the Nov 6 fix (PlayerTransport.tsx); re-check on phone.
  • Rule 50, 70: not enforced (offline: +30 forward, no gap).
  • Rule 67: not enforced. app/account/settings/page.tsx shows fake speed, autoplay, skip-silence, sleep-timer, download and notification controls.
  • Rules 68–69, 71–73, 76, 78: enforced in code.

body:
Status: APPROVED (Marc, Nov 9, 2026: "approve canon 01–15") · Owner: Marc · Changes only through CANON-99 (CANON-00 rules 10–16)

Covers: everything a listener sees outside the player: sign-up and sign-in, free trial, prices and plans, Stripe billing, cancel and refunds, the paywall, guests, Home, Library and story cards, the red Rate button, reviews, playlists, genres and search, account and settings, name personalization settings, referrals, story suggestions, ad landing pages, emails, accessibility, and privacy and legal pages. Does not cover: what happens inside the player (CANON-11 The Player); how stories are made and published (story pipeline canon); ad campaigns, budgets and CAC (marketing canon); revenue reports (finance canon).

Where Marc decides

Every rule in this document that needs Marc. MARC DECIDES = Marc approves, chooses or gives his OK. MARC DOES = something only Marc does himself (tests on his phone, listens, enters a key). The same tag marks each rule below.

  • Rule 10 MARC DECIDES: The Founding Member plan is retired. No page may offer it without a new pricing decision from Marc.
  • Rule 60 MARC DECIDES: A new landing story serves only after Marc adds it to the live list.
  • Rule 68 MARC DECIDES: Push notifications are off until Marc approves what they say and when.
  • Rule 73 MARC DOES: Marc checks every listener-facing change on a real phone before it is accepted.
  • Decision 132 MARC DOES: Marc or a blind tester runs the core path with VoiceOver on a real phone before any release or outreach to blind or low-vision listeners.
  • Still open: nothing. Every conflict and question below is RESOLVED (CANON-99 Parts 1 and 2, Nov 9, 2026).

Rules

A. Sign-up and sign-in

  1. Magic-link sign-in finishes on the client at /auth/confirm so it works in the iPhone Home Screen app. All sign-in cookies use sameSite "none" and secure. Never revert this. — Agreed (memory /areas/endless-tales-platform.md)
  2. A new listener's name comes only from the first and last name they registered with, never from an email address or a card name. — In force (code) (lib/signupName.ts)
  3. After sign-up, the listener goes back into the exact story they were sampling, at the spot they stopped. — Agreed (Marc's iPhone test Nov 6, chat "Cover story map pattern": "It should have started where I left off in the story I listened to"; POST-SIGNUP-RETURN-001, lib/landing.ts)
  4. Right after sign-up, Belle greets the listener by first name in a short welcome. If the clip isn't ready, the app continues without it. — Agreed (BELLE-WELCOME-001 Marc Aug 11; BELL-ONBOARD-001 Marc Aug 23; app/api/go/invite-signup/route.ts)
  5. For a signed-in listener, tapping the logo goes straight to Home. — Agreed (WALK-BUG-0713 #8, Marc Jul 13, components/AppHeader.tsx)

B. Prices, plans and the free trial

  1. Prices: $9.99 per month or $79.99 per year. — Agreed (Marc, Oct 2026: chats "CAC for self-funding", "Meta ad test plan", "Pocket FM… pricing"; memory bell-meta-marketing.md; lib/pricing.ts)
  2. Free trial: 14 days on every sign-up path. — Agreed (same sources; PRICING-TRIAL-001, lib/pricing.ts)
  3. A card is required to start the trial. — Agreed (chat "CAC for self-funding" Oct 2026: "Card-required, 14-day trial" approved for the Meta test; memory meta-campaign plan). See Conflict C2.
  4. lib/pricing.ts is the one place the app gets prices and trial length. It must match Stripe. — In force (code) (lib/pricing.ts)
  5. MARC DECIDES The Founding Member plan is retired. No page may offer it without a new pricing decision from Marc. — Agreed (ATL-FM-RETIRE-001, Marc Jul 10, app/api/checkout/route.ts)
  6. The trial length is decided by the server, never by the web page. Allowed values: 7, 14, 21 or 30 days. — In force (code) (app/api/checkout/route.ts)
  7. Customer-facing pages never show a raw promo code. They say "Special offer applied". — Agreed (ORION-GO-OFFER-COPY-001, Marc Jul 12)
  8. The Meta test sells subscriptions only. Pay-per-story or a week pass is tested later, as its own test. — Agreed (memory business-model.md, Nov 4)
  9. A $4.99 one-week pass (no auto-renew, credited toward the annual plan within a month). — Proposed (Marc was weighing it Nov 4; not decided)

C. Billing, cancel and refunds

  1. A listener cancels in Account → Billing. Cancelling stops the next charge. Access continues to the end of the paid period. — In force (code) (app/api/user/cancel-subscription, cancel_at_period_end; app/terms/page.tsx)
  2. Fees are not refunded except where the law requires or an offer says so. Billing questions go to hello@endless-tales.com. — In force (code) (app/terms/page.tsx). Needs Marc's OK (Q4).
  3. A failed renewal does not cut access right away. Access stays while Stripe retries. Only a final failure ends access. — Agreed (CARD-ON-FILE-001, "Marc GO" Oct 5, app/api/webhook/route.ts)
  4. A listener has access only when their plan is active and its end date is in the future. — In force (code) (lib/subscription.ts)

D. Paywall and guests

  1. A signed-in listener who never had a trial and opens a paid story goes to the Subscribe page. — In force (code) (CanonicalPlayer.tsx paywall)
  2. After a trial ends without paying: a standalone story plays 60 seconds, then a Belle "subscribe" wall; a series plays all of Episode 1, then the wall; Episode 2 and later are blocked at once. — In force (code) (POST-TRIAL-BELLE-001, CanonicalPlayer.tsx). Older memory says "free Episode 1 forever after the trial" — Agreed (memory /areas/endless-tales-platform.md); code matches for series only.
  3. Never cut audio mid-drive. A paywall shows at the start of the next story, not in the middle of one. — Proposed (rule 20's 60-second wall stops a standalone mid-play; see Q5)
  4. A no-card trial listener who arrived from an ad sees a card-capture screen at the end of Episode 2. — Agreed (GO-REROUTE-V2, Marc Oct 5, CanonicalPlayer.tsx). See Conflict C2.
  5. Guests (not signed in) can play only stories marked free. After 2 stories or 30 minutes, they see a sign-up prompt. — In force (code) (app/guest/page.tsx)

E. Home page

  1. The Continue card heading reads "Continue your last story here". — Agreed (HOME-POLISH-001, Marc Nov 6, components/player/PersistentPlayer.tsx)
  2. Continue card layout: line 1 the series title in bold (or story title), up to 2 lines; line 2 "Episode N · episode title"; line 3 time played and time left; cover 56 pixels; "Remove ×" top right; Continue bottom right. — Agreed (Marc Nov 5, PR #493, chat "Apple App Store commission deals")
  3. The Continue card is one shade lighter than story cards, the same as My Playlist. — Agreed (CARD-SHADE-001, Marc Nov 6)
  4. The Continue card shows on Home and Library only. — In force (code) (PersistentPlayer.tsx)
  5. No news features. Never add news briefings. — Agreed (memory /areas/endless-tales-platform.md)

F. Library and story cards

  1. One story card everywhere (components/LibraryStoryCard.tsx). Every page that shows a story uses it. — Agreed (WALK-BUG-0713 #7, Marc Jul 13)
  2. The card shows an "N Episode(s)" pill, author and genre, stars with a count, and a short description. — Agreed (Marc Oct 4, LibraryStoryCard.tsx)
  3. The description fills two lines on the card and never spills to a third. — Agreed (memory story-pipeline.md, Nov 5). See Conflict C6.
  4. Every card has three buttons. Left: Listen (orange), Continue Listening (green), or Play Again. Center: Add to Playlist (blue), or On Playlist (lighter blue). Right: Read (amber), or Continue Reading (green). All three are the same size. — Agreed (Marc Oct 4, 7 and 8, LibraryStoryCard.tsx)
  5. When a story or a whole series is finished and not yet reviewed, the center button turns red "Rate this story/series" until the listener reviews it. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md; Marc Nov 8)
  6. Tapping the cover opens the story's info page. — Agreed (Marc Oct 7, LibraryStoryCard.tsx)
  7. Only live stories appear: published, not hidden, and for a series, all episodes live. No 1-episode series is ever shown. — Agreed (docs/PLAYER-RULES.md "What listeners can see"; memory story-pipeline.md and hook-series.md, Nov 8)
  8. A story marked "Not for me" stays out of the listener's Home recommendations. — In force (code) (user_library.not_for_me)
  9. When an author has 2 or more stories, the author page shows "Show all stories by {author name}". — Agreed (Marc Nov 5 request; project to-do G26). Not built yet.

G. Ratings and reviews

  1. A review is 1 to 5 stars with optional text. One review per listener per story or series. — In force (code) (app/api/reviews/submit/route.ts)
  2. Reviews never pay credits. Endless Tales has no credits. — Proposed (the review route still awards "review credits", a leftover from the old credit model; see Conflict C4)
  3. A series is rated once, as a whole, from its card or after its last episode. — Proposed (fills the gap behind rule 33)

H. Playlists

  1. A playlist is the listener's own list, built with "Add to Playlist". It can hold standalone stories and whole series. It plays in order. — In force (code) (lib/playlistState.ts). Open in PLAYER-RULES; see Q1.
  2. Adding a story to the playlist also saves it for offline listening (every episode of a series). Removing it deletes the offline copy. A failed download never blocks the add. — Agreed (QUEUE-OFFLINE-001, Marc Oct 4, app/library/page.tsx)
  3. The My Playlist bar shows "Play" until the listener starts it, then "Continue". — Agreed (QUEUE-OFFLINE-001, Marc Oct 4)
  4. On the Library, My Playlist is a slim one-row bar so more cards fit. — Agreed (CARD-COMPACT-001, Marc Nov 6)
  5. The playlist is saved to the listener's account and follows them to any device. — Proposed (today it lives only in that phone's browser storage; PLAYER-RULES says progress follows the listener, the playlist should too)

I. Genres, browse and search

  1. Genres follow GENRE-ATTRIBUTES-SPEC (locked). The old genre lists (Children, Non-Fiction, Trucker Stories, credits) are retired. — Agreed (memory /areas/endless-tales-platform.md: "GENRE-ATTRIBUTES-SPEC v1.0 … locked")
  2. Search finds stories by title, series name and author, and shows only live stories. — Proposed (no current rule)

J. Account, settings and name personalization

  1. Account shows name, email, member-since date, billing, history, downloads, help and the Travel Insights choice (Always / Never / Only while using). Travel Insights is off until the listener turns it on. — In force (code) (app/account/page.tsx)
  2. Every control on the Settings page must work. Controls that save nothing are removed until they are built. — Proposed (app/account/settings/page.tsx shows speed, autoplay, skip silence, sleep timer, download and notification controls that do nothing)
  3. A listener can correct the first name Belle uses and hear a sample before saving. — Proposed (no setting exists; a wrong name in every intro is a fast way to lose a subscriber)
  4. A listener can delete their account from Account. — In force (code) (app/api/user/delete). Confirm it is reachable on the page.

K. Referrals and story suggestions

  1. A referral link (?ref=CODE) is saved on any page and survives sign-in. The newest link wins. — In force (code) (lib/referral.ts, REFERRAL-SIGNUP-001)
  2. Referral reward is free days for both people (default 14 each). The friend gets theirs after their first successful payment; the referrer gets theirs only after the friend's first payment. Each side is paid once. — In force (code) (lib/referralPayout.ts)
  3. A referral trial never starts a second trial at checkout. — In force (code) (lib/referralInvitation.ts)
  4. Story suggestions are sent from Account → Suggest a Story. The Terms explain the license the listener grants. — In force (code) (app/account/suggest-story, app/terms/page.tsx)
  5. Custom (paid, one-time) stories are not offered yet. — Proposed (finance code has a "Custom stories" revenue line; no listener page exists; see Q6)

L. Ad landing pages

  1. Each Meta ad lands on its own story: /go?v=widow, rise, miami, rerouted or home. The page plays that story's real Episode 1, so the spot carries into the app after sign-up. — Agreed (HOOK-LANDING-001 and AD-LINKS-001, Nov 6, chat "Cover story map pattern"; lib/landing.ts)
  2. Ad links are copied only from the official list, never typed. Before approval, someone opens each ad's link on a phone and confirms the story title matches the ad. — Agreed (AD-LINKS-001, Nov 6)
  3. A landing link with an unknown code shows a clear error, never a different story. — Proposed (today it silently plays The Grave He Dug Himself; this caused 2 wrong ad links on Nov 6)
  4. MARC DECIDES A new landing story serves only after Marc adds it to the live list. — Agreed (approval gate, lib/landing.ts GO_LIVE_VARIANTS)
  5. The trial button is hidden at first and slides up after 45 seconds of real listening (each story can set its own time). — Agreed (SUS/ATL-LANDING-002 rev C, "Marc final spec"; Falls Park ~100 seconds, Marc)
  6. Trial button copy: "Card required — you won't be charged before your N-day free trial ends. Then just $X/month. Cancel anytime." Days and price come from lib/pricing.ts. — Agreed (Marc verbatim, msg 3015, Jul 19, lib/landing.ts)
  7. Footnote under the button: "After you sign up, we'll pick up right where you left off." — Agreed (GO-FOOTNOTE-001, Marc Nov 6)
  8. The Subscribe page has no app header for ad arrivals; organic visitors keep the header. — Agreed (ORION-SUB-CHROME-001, Marc Jul 12)

M. Emails and notifications

  1. Emails during a trial: welcome at trial start; a day-1 "add to Home Screen" email; reminders on days 2, 12 and 13 (no-card trials only); and Stripe's billing reminder before a card trial is charged. — Agreed (Marc approved the card-trial email fix, chat "Gemini sound replacement loop", Nov 5; app/api/cron/trial-emails, app/api/webhook)
  2. A card-trial listener never gets copy that says "no card", "nothing to cancel" or "nothing will be charged". — Agreed (same, Nov 5; enforced by stripe_subscription_id filter)
  3. Every marketing or reminder email has a one-click unsubscribe. — In force (code) (lib/emails/unsubscribe.ts)
  4. MARC DECIDES Push notifications are off until Marc approves what they say and when. — Proposed (Settings shows notification toggles that do nothing)

N. Accessibility and look

  1. Dark background, white text only. Never grey text on dark. Orange for emphasis. — Agreed (memory /areas/endless-tales-platform.md "DTT website = dark background + WHITE text only"; MASTER_RULES.md; docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)
  2. Every button a listener taps is at least 44 pixels tall. — Proposed for the whole app (Agreed for the player only, docs/PLAYER-RULES.md). See Conflict C5.
  3. Body text is at least 16 pixels; small labels at least 14 pixels. — Proposed (large readable text; many labels today are 11–12 pixels)
  4. Nothing spills sideways on phones, tablets or computers. — Proposed for the whole app (Agreed for the player)
  5. MARC DOES Marc checks every listener-facing change on a real phone before it is accepted. — Agreed (memory profile: tests every step on his phone; docs/PLAYER-RULES.md)

O. Privacy and legal

  1. The app has Terms, Privacy and Content License pages. Prices in them come from lib/pricing.ts. — In force (code) (app/terms, app/privacy, app/license)
  2. Listeners must be 13 or older. — In force (code) (app/terms, app/privacy)
  3. Offline downloads are temporary licensed copies, not purchases. — In force (code) (app/terms)
  4. The legal pages name the company that runs Endless Tales. — Proposed wording: Endless Tales, LLC (see Conflict C7)

Marc's decisions (Nov 9, 2026)

Marc answered CANON-99 on Nov 9, 2026. These decisions are Agreed and override any rule above that says otherwise. Each conflict or question below that they settle is marked RESOLVED.

  • Decision 8: Story card description. Decided: fills two lines, never a third (about 100 characters), checked in one place. The old 24-word and 70-character limits go. (03 C4, 12 C6) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 50: What a playlist is. Decided: the listener's own "Add to Playlist" list, saved to their account; finished stories drop off. (12 Q1, Q2) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 51: Paywall. Decided: the paywall never cuts audio mid-story; after a trial, Episode 1 of every series stays free. (11 Q5, 12 Q3, Q5) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 52: Prices and trial. Decided: $9.99/month, $79.99/year; 14-day trial with a card required for ad traffic; refund once within 7 days of the first charge. Fix the old $7.99 numbers everywhere. (12 C1–C3, Q4, 13 C1, C2) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 53: Old models. Decided: retire credits and Founding Member everywhere. (12 C4, C8) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 54: Readability and legal name. Decided: 44-pixel buttons app-wide; legal pages name Endless Tales, LLC. (12 C5, C7) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 55: Settings page. Decided: remove the controls that don't work; no speed control or sleep timer for now. (11 Q2, 12 Q7) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 99: An unknown ad link shows a clear error, never a different story. (12 C9) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 100: No custom stories until after the Meta test. (12 Q6) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 101: Offer the annual plan at the end of the trial. (12 Q8) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 102: Keep the free guest stories (2 stories / 30 minutes). (12 Q9) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 132: Screen-reader access, web and native. Decided: every listener screen on the web and in the future iPhone, Android, CarPlay and Android Auto apps works with VoiceOver and TalkBack: every button, link and field has a spoken name; reading order follows the screen; text grows with the phone's text-size setting; text contrast is at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text); tap targets are at least 44 pixels. Buttons keep white text (rule 69) on darker shades (orange #c2410c, green #15803d). The native apps build this in from the first screen and are not released until they pass. MARC DOES Marc or a blind tester runs the core path (sign up, trial, pay, browse, pick, play, pause, skip, next episode) with VoiceOver on a real phone before any release or outreach to blind or low-vision listeners. — Agreed (Marc, Nov 10, 2026, CANON-99 item 132)

Conflicts found

  • C1. [RESOLVED by decision 52, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Prices. Code and Oct–Nov chats: $9.99/month, $79.99/year (lib/pricing.ts, Sep 19). Older: $7.99/$59.99 "confirmed by Marc 2026-06-05" (app/api/admin/org-status/route.ts) and memory /areas/endless-tales-platform.md; app/api/admin/launch-report/route.ts still computes revenue at $7.99/$59.99. Recommendation: $9.99/$79.99 wins (newer); fix the report. Marc decides.
  • C2. [RESOLVED by decision 52, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Card at trial start. Oct 2026: card required (chat "CAC for self-funding"; /go copy says "Card required"). Code still runs no-card trials (/listen and /go invitation sign-ups, app/api/listen/signup, app/api/go/invite-signup) and the Oct 5 "card wall after Episode 2" for them. All 49 trials to Nov 5 were no-card. Recommendation: card required for all ad traffic; keep no-card only for referral invitations, or retire it. Marc decides.
  • C3. [RESOLVED by decision 52, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Trial length. Memory (older): "7-day no-card free trial". Code and Oct–Nov: 14 days everywhere. Recommendation: 14 days wins. Marc decides.
  • C4. [RESOLVED by decision 53, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Credits. The review route still awards "review credits", and mockups/MASTER-UI-BIBLE.md, FLAG_RULES.md and DTT-LAUNCH-PLAN.md describe a credits/"Owned" model. The app is subscription-only. Recommendation: retire credits everywhere. Marc decides.
  • C5. [RESOLVED by decision 54, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Button size. Card buttons were set to 38 pixels (CARD-COMPACT-001, Marc Nov 6). The 44-pixel rule (PLAYER-RULES, Nov 9) covers the player only. Recommendation: 44 pixels app-wide (newer, and Marc's own readability need). Marc decides.
  • C6. [RESOLVED by decision 8, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Card description. Marc Nov 5: fills two lines, never a third. Code: cut at 70 characters (LibraryStoryCard.tsx). Recommendation: Marc's two-line rule wins. Marc decides.
  • C7. [RESOLVED by decision 54, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Company name. Terms, Privacy and License say "operated by Wonder Books Press". The subscriber company is Endless Tales, LLC (D-U-N-S legal name, Nov 5). Recommendation: Endless Tales, LLC; confirm with legal. Marc decides.
  • C8. [RESOLVED by decision 53, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Founding Member retired (Marc Jul 10) but app/api/webhook/route.ts still labels "$29.99/year" Founding Member, and Admin org-status still lists it. Recommendation: remove. Marc decides.
  • C9. [RESOLVED by decision 99, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Landing fallback. Rule 57 says each ad lands on its own story. lib/landing.ts silently serves the default story for any unknown code. Recommendation: show an error instead (rule 59). Marc decides.

Open questions for Marc

  • Q1. [RESOLVED by decision 50, Marc Nov 9, 2026] What is a playlist? Suggested answer: the listener's own "Add to Playlist" list (as built), saved to their account so it follows them; no genre queue for now.
  • Q2. [RESOLVED by decision 50, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Should each listener keep their playlist after it finishes, or does it empty as it plays (today finished items drop off)? Suggested answer: drop finished items, as now.
  • Q3. [RESOLVED by decision 51, Marc Nov 9, 2026] After a trial ends, what may a non-paying listener still hear? Suggested answer: Episode 1 of every series, free forever (your earlier rule), and 60 seconds of a standalone.
  • Q4. [RESOLVED by decision 52, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Refunds: keep "no refunds except where law requires", or allow a refund within 7 days of the first charge? Suggested answer: one refund within 7 days of the first charge, to limit card disputes.
  • Q5. [RESOLVED by decision 51, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Can the paywall ever stop audio mid-story? Suggested answer: no; the wall shows when the next story starts.
  • Q6. [RESOLVED by decision 100, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Custom stories (a listener orders a story made for them): offer it, and at what price? Suggested answer: not until after the Meta test.
  • Q7. [RESOLVED by decision 55, Marc Nov 9, 2026] What should the Settings page keep? Suggested answer: only working items (account, Travel Insights, eBook text size); remove the rest until built.
  • Q8. [RESOLVED by decision 101, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Annual plan push: offer annual at the end of the trial? Suggested answer: yes, it is the main money lever (Bart, Nov 3).
  • Q9. [RESOLVED by decision 102, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Should guests get any free story without signing up, now that ads land on /go samples? Suggested answer: keep the free guest stories, same 2-story / 30-minute limit.

body:
Status: APPROVED (Marc, Nov 9, 2026: "approve canon 01–15") · Owner: Marc · Changes only through CANON-99 (CANON-00 rules 10–16)

Covers: who may build, approve, launch and pause ads; ad testing (Amendment 1); ad budgets and CAC test rules; hook-first ad creative; landing; tracking; TikTok, influencers and other channels; ad accounts. Does not cover: how plow back and ad spend are counted on the books (CANON-14 Finance & Reporting); agent roster, merges and deploys (CANON-15 Agents & Operations); how hook-series stories are written and published (PIPELINE-CANON / story production canon); the listener app and player (PLAYER-RULES).

Where Marc decides

Every rule in this document that needs Marc. MARC DECIDES = Marc approves, chooses or gives his OK. MARC DOES = something only Marc does himself (tests on his phone, listens, enters a key). The same tag marks each rule below.

  • Rule 1 MARC DECIDES: No ad spends money or goes live until Marc approves its creative and its budget.
  • Rule 5 MARC DECIDES: Susan writes ad copy with Claude through her own key, capped at $25 a month. Marc approves the final copy.
  • Rule 8 MARC DECIDES: Any new idea for an agent's role in ads (for example, Strategos sending his brief straight to Susan) needs Marc's word before it is used.
  • Rule 12 MARC DECIDES: If Meta's preview won't load, the card says "INTERNAL SIMULATION — NOT META'S PREVIEW" and Approve stays off. Only Marc can override, in writing.
  • Rule 16 MARC DOES: Marc tests every ad himself, on his phone, before it is uploaded or launched.

  • Rule 22 MARC DECIDES: LAUNCH appears only after Marc approves, and only for Susan and Orion. Each launch records who and when.
  • Rule 25 MARC DOES: The Meta write key (ads_management) lives only on the server. Marc enters it himself. Susan never holds it; she calls the gated route.
  • Rule 34 MARC DECIDES: Weekly spend never goes over the weekly plan without Marc's approval.
  • Rule 41 MARC DECIDES: After the test, monthly ad spend may not go over that month's "Available for ads" amount (plow back, defined in CANON-14) without Marc's approval.
  • Rule 51 MARC DECIDES: Low-cost video promo clips (one still image per scene, slow pan, story audio) are a future option only. No build until Marc approves a test, and…
  • Rule 61 MARC DOES: TikTok ads use the same approval card, 6 checks, Marc's phone test and playbook read as Meta before any spend.
  • Decision 105 MARC DECIDES: Meta's own phone preview never counts as approval, except as a written, dated, one-time override by Marc.
  • Decision 107 MARC DECIDES: After the $4,000 test, the monthly ad budget is "Available for ads"; more needs Marc's approval.
  • Decision 109 MARC DOES: "Owner tested personally" must be ticked before Approve works.

  • Still open: nothing. Every conflict and question below is RESOLVED (CANON-99 Parts 1 and 2, Nov 9, 2026).

Rules

A. Who decides

  1. MARC DECIDES No ad spends money or goes live until Marc approves its creative and its budget. — Agreed (memory agent-fleet.md; chat "CAC for self-funding", summary claude/chat-summary-meta-poc-cac-goals-2026-11-02.md)
  2. Strategos picks the audience and the message. Susan builds and places the ads against Strategos's pick. Neither can spend or publish for Marc. — Agreed (memory agent-fleet.md, bell-meta-marketing.md, Nov 2)
  3. No campaign on any platform (Meta, TikTok or later) is built until both Strategos and Susan have read the full "Endless Tales — Susan Playbook (CANONICAL)" Drive folder. If the folder can't be read, the build stops until it can. — Agreed (Marc ruling Nov 1, 2026; chat "Audio story app CAC planning"; project doc claude/chat-summary-susan-strategos-playbook-gate-2026-11-02.md)
  4. Orion sends no ad-build task unless it cites the playbook read and Strategos's audience pick. — Agreed (Nov 1, 2026, Marc said "Yes" to the structural gate; same chat)
  5. MARC DECIDES Susan writes ad copy with Claude through her own key, capped at $25 a month. Marc approves the final copy. — Agreed (memory agent-fleet.md, Nov 8; chat "Apple App Store commission deals", Nov 5: Marc approved hook-ad copy)
  6. Hal cuts the ad videos. — Agreed (Marc: "Confirm Hal", Nov 1, chat "Audio story app CAC planning")
  7. Earlier failed tests (GVL-TEST-001, Bell Arm 2) are ignored. New campaigns start fresh, without their data. — Agreed (memory bell-meta-marketing.md; chat "Meta ad test plan for Endless Tales")
  8. MARC DECIDES Any new idea for an agent's role in ads (for example, Strategos sending his brief straight to Susan) needs Marc's word before it is used. — Proposed (fills C6 below)

B. Testing and approving every ad (Amendment 1)

  1. Every Meta campaign gets a Campaign Approval Card in Admin → Marketing → Approvals. — Agreed (docs/specs/amendment-1-ad-preview-and-testing-spec.md, approved Oct 29, 2026; AGENTS.md canon index)
  2. The card shows Meta's real preview for each placement (Facebook and Instagram mobile, video with sound), the real headline, text and button, and the exact destination link. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §2–3)
  3. Meta's preview frames expire in 24 hours. The card fetches them fresh every time and never stores them. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §3.3)
  4. MARC DECIDES If Meta's preview won't load, the card says "INTERNAL SIMULATION — NOT META'S PREVIEW" and Approve stays off. Only Marc can override, in writing. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §3.7)
  5. The card has 6 checks, each Pass / Fail / Not Tested: video and sound, destination link, signup, checkout, conversion tracking, phone. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §5)
  6. Checkout must show $9.99 a month, $79.99 a year, 14-day free trial, card required. Tests use Stripe test mode only. No real charge is possible from a test. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §5.4, §6.6)
  7. Test users are marked is_test_account. Test visits never reach real analytics or Meta's learning (pixel off, test event code on). — Agreed (Amendment 1 §6.4)
  8. MARC DOES Marc tests every ad himself, on his phone, before it is uploaded or launched. — Agreed (Nov 4, 2026, project doc claude/hook-first-ads-2026-11-04.md; PIPELINE-CANON HOOK-SERIES RULE; memory profile)
  9. The "Owner tested personally" box must be ticked before APPROVE works. — Proposed (rule 16 is not enforced by the card today)
  10. APPROVE stays off until all 6 checks Pass on the current version. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §7.1)
  11. MARC DECIDES Approval covers only the exact version tested. Any change to video, headline, text, button, link, claims or spend ceiling makes a new version that needs approval again. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §4; memory meta-campaign-approval.md)
  12. Susan builds ads in Meta as PAUSED drafts only. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §3.1)
  13. Only the card's LAUNCH button turns an ad on. It re-checks the version against live Meta data and refuses if anything changed. No one launches from Meta Ads Manager. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §7.4, §10.2, §10.6)
  14. MARC DECIDES LAUNCH appears only after Marc approves, and only for Susan and Orion. Each launch records who and when. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §10.1, §10.3)
  15. Marc, Susan or Orion may PAUSE at any time without approval. Resuming needs a new LAUNCH on an approved, unchanged version. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §10.5)
  16. Susan and Orion are told when Marc approves or declines. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §10.4)
  17. MARC DOES The Meta write key (ads_management) lives only on the server. Marc enters it himself. Susan never holds it; she calls the gated route. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §7.5; Marc's decision in chat "Meta campaign testing plan", Oct 30)
  18. The Meta write key must be on the server that runs the app and Susan's tools (EC2), not only on Vercel. — Proposed (Nov 7 finding: the key was put in Vercel, so Susan could not use it; see C10)
  19. The builder of the approval system never checks its own work. A separate fresh helper verifies. — Agreed (Marc's decision, chat "Meta campaign testing plan", Oct 29–30)
  20. Claude builds the card into the Marketing dashboard. Orion verifies it before launches are turned on. Susan makes sure the card matches what is set up in Meta. — Agreed (memory meta-campaign-approval.md)
  21. Approval pages use a light background, black text, body text 18px or larger, buttons 22px or larger. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §1.4)

C. The first test: money and goals

  1. No $15,000+ ad spend before a proof of concept. — Agreed (memory bell-meta-marketing.md)
  2. The first Meta test is "6+2": $4,000 of ads over 6 weeks, then 2 weeks for trials to turn into paid. — Agreed (memory bell-meta-marketing.md; chat "Meta campaign testing plan")
  3. The goal is a paid CAC (ad cost per paying subscriber) under $30 by week 8. — Agreed (chat "Meta campaign testing plan"; chat "Meta ad campaign for 6+2")
  4. Weekly plan: $500, $500, $700, $700, $800, $800, then $0, $0. Forecast: 270 trials, 135 paid, $29.63 CAC. — Agreed (owner-identified final workbook Oct 29; docs/ADMIN-MARKETING-WORKBOOK.md; lib/admin-center/meta-test-plan.ts)
  5. MARC DECIDES Weekly spend never goes over the weekly plan without Marc's approval. — Proposed (Strategos rule; still marked "awaiting approval", see Q1)
  6. Stop rules: pause for revision if cost per trial is worse than $22.50 after $600 spent; stop if worse than $25.00; stop if blended CAC is worse than $45.00 once measurable. — Proposed (Strategos; lib/admin-center/meta-test-plan.ts; Marc had not approved as of Nov 7, chat "Sunset episode 8 artifact")
  7. Per-ad early signs: cost per page load $1.17 or better (worse than $1.75 after $75 spent is bad); cost per signup $9.33 or better (worse than $15 after $75–150 is bad). — Proposed (same source)
  8. Trial-to-paid is judged only after 30 trials are 14 days old. Under 35% means fix onboarding, not ads. — Proposed (same source; Claude's 30-trial advice, Oct 30)
  9. No changes to an ad in its first 3 days unless it breaks a stop rule. — Proposed (same source)
  10. The $400 reserve goes to the winning ad only after $600 spent, 10+ trials per ad set aged 14 days, cost per trial $15 or less, and early paid rate 40% or more. — Proposed (same source)
  11. The Meta test sells subscriptions only. A pay-per-week pass is tested afterward. — Agreed (Nov 4, memory business-model.md)
  12. MARC DECIDES After the test, monthly ad spend may not go over that month's "Available for ads" amount (plow back, defined in CANON-14) without Marc's approval. — Proposed (connects plow back to a spending cap; Marc decided the plow back amount, not the cap)

D. Ad creative: hook-first

  1. Write ad hooks first, pick the strongest, then build new stories around the winning hooks. Hooks are not clipped from old stories. — Agreed (Nov 4, memory bell-meta-marketing.md; project doc claude/hook-first-ads-2026-11-04.md)
  2. The hook is the first spoken line of Episode 1. The ad is the first 20–25 seconds of Episode 1, with real AI story images and the end card "Hear what happens next. Free 14-day trial." — Agreed (PIPELINE-CANON HOOK-SERIES RULE, Nov 5; claude/hook-first-ads-2026-11-04.md)
  3. Each ad lands on its exact story, never the app home page. — Agreed (PIPELINE-CANON HOOK-SERIES RULE)
  4. Hook ads launch one series at a time, as each series is ready. — Agreed (Nov 6, memory hook-series.md)
  5. An ad never sends people to a story with only one episode live. — Agreed (Nov 8, memory hook-series.md: no 1-episode stories live)
  6. A winning hook is judged by cost per trial and by the share of trial users who reach Episode 3 or later. — Agreed (PIPELINE-CANON HOOK-SERIES RULE)
  7. Ads are vertical 9:16 video with burned-in captions, because Meta plays feed video muted. — Agreed (governance/ACQUISITION-RETENTION-001.md E1; Susan handoff Marc sent Nov 2)
  8. Placements favor Reels and Stories, where people watch with sound. — Agreed (Nov 5, chat "Apple App Store commission deals")
  9. Skip hooks likely to draw Meta policy review (Marc skipped the visa-marriage hook). — Proposed (one past decision; no general rule yet)
  10. MARC DECIDES Low-cost video promo clips (one still image per scene, slow pan, story audio) are a future option only. No build until Marc approves a test, and only if data shows other creative is weak. Never in the main app. — Agreed (memory bell-meta-marketing.md)

E. Landing and tracking

  1. The destination page must load with the story's hero image and its listen button above the fold on a phone. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §5.2)
  2. The landing button invites the listener to "overhear" (not a media player). Pressing it starts the audio at the very first line. — Agreed (governance/ACQUISITION-RETENTION-001.md E2)
  3. Signup and trial-start events go to Meta from both the page and the server, with one shared event ID so they count once. — Agreed (Amendment 1 §11.1–11.2)
  4. utm_campaign must exactly match the campaign name, so paying subscribers trace back to their campaign. — Agreed (docs/CODEX_CAMPAIGN_SYSTEM_SPEC.md §3 "Confirmed decisions", May 7, 2026)
  5. Real CAC per campaign = ad spend over the campaign's life ÷ real (non-test) paying subscribers with that utm_campaign. — In force (code) (lib/finance/statement.ts, campaigns section)
  6. Dashboard numbers from Meta must use an exact date range and the exact ad set, never a "lifetime" preset. — Proposed (Aug 2026 fix in memory bell-meta-marketing.md is not in the current route; see enforcement)
  7. Susan's data feed is read-only (Meta ads_read, TikTok Reporting). It strips personal data and cannot create, change or pay for ads. — In force (code) (docs/SUSAN-MARKETING-API.md; app/api/marketing/meta-insights, tiktok-insights)

F. Older campaign system (Airtable)

  1. Before a campaign is approved, a 90-day cash test must show cash stays above the floor: the larger of $5,000 or 90 days of spending. — Agreed (docs/CODEX_CAMPAIGN_SYSTEM_SPEC.md §3, May 7, 2026; shipped app/api/cron/stress-test)
  2. No more than 3 campaigns run at once (soft limit). — Agreed (same spec §3)

G. Other channels

  1. MARC DOES TikTok ads use the same approval card, 6 checks, Marc's phone test and playbook read as Meta before any spend. — Proposed (TikTok is planned as "eventually"; no TikTok approval rule exists)
  2. Influencer and PR outreach uses public, legal channels only (press databases, platform DMs, business emails). No scraping of private emails. Cold emails follow CAN-SPAM. — Proposed (chat "Reaching celebrities and influencers about AI"; purpose still undecided)
  3. Mail-in QR test at local stores waits until after the Meta test. — Proposed (chat "QR code marketing system", Nov 3; idea only)

H. Ad accounts

  1. The Bizgojo and Foxfire Mountain Meta ad accounts are no longer used for Endless Tales. — Agreed (Nov 8, memory meta-ad-accounts.md)
  2. Endless Tales ads run from one ad account named for Endless Tales, paid by the ad-spend card. — Proposed (no rule says which account runs ads; see Q3)

Marc's decisions (Nov 9, 2026)

Marc answered CANON-99 on Nov 9, 2026. These decisions are Agreed and override any rule above that says otherwise. Each conflict or question below that they settle is marked RESOLVED.

  • Decision 1: Hook series ads start when? Nov 6 said "after Episodes 2 and 3 are live"; Nov 8 said all 7 episodes publish together. Decided: ads start only after all 7 Season 1 episodes are live. (09 C1, 13 C5) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 12: Retire old manual documents as history: STORY_PRODUCTION_PROCESS v1.2, SCRIPT_VALIDATOR.md, STORY_GRADING_RUBRIC.md, STORY_BRIEF_TEMPLATE v2.2, NEDS scoring, character-attachment scoring, MASTER_RULES.md, DEPLOY.md, DEPLOYMENT-RUNBOOK.md, HAL_SESSION_START_PROTOCOL.md, MIX_SPEC.md and MIX_NOTE_PROTOCOL.md level tables, et_mix_assembly.py, ACQUISITION-RETENTION-001 Parts A, D, E. Decided: yes, all. (01 C1, 02 C4, Q5, Q6, 03 Q7, 07 C4, C6, 13 C9, 15 C3–C5) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 52: Prices and trial. Decided: $9.99/month, $79.99/year; 14-day trial with a card required for ad traffic; refund once within 7 days of the first charge. Fix the old $7.99 numbers everywhere. (12 C1–C3, Q4, 13 C1, C2) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 56: Meta. Decided: Approve Strategos's stop rules as written. Meta optimizes for Trial Start. CAC goal is under $30; stop above $45. Agents reach Meta only through the gated server routes. Ads run from a new or renamed Endless Tales ad account. (13 C3, C4, C7, Q1–Q3) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 57: Plow back. Marc's decision: the plow-back percentage is a setting that starts at 75%; only Marc changes it, each change is recorded with its date and applies from the next month on. Plow back = that percentage of the previous month's profit ($0 after a loss month), shown as one number ("Available for ads"). The Command Center reads the same setting. The rest stays as reserve. Minimum cash reserve: $5,000 or 90 days of spending, whichever is larger. (13 C8, 14 C3, C4, Q1, Q3) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99)
  • Decision 103: Strategos sends his brief straight to Susan; Marc's gate is the approval card before launch. (13 C6) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 104: The Meta key lives in the EC2 server's settings (not Vercel). (13 C10) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 105: Meta's own phone preview never counts as approval, except as a written, dated, one-time override by Marc. (13 C11) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 106: Retire the Airtable campaign system; keep its cash-floor test on the approval card. (13 Q4) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)

  • Decision 108: Decide what influencer/PR outreach is for after the Meta test. (13 Q6) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 109: "Owner tested personally" must be ticked before Approve works. (13 Q7) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)
  • Decision 110: Amendment 1 is overridden only in writing on the approval card, with the date. (13 Q8) — Agreed (Marc, Nov 9, 2026, CANON-99 Part 2)

Conflicts found

  • C1. [RESOLVED by decision 52, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Price. Amendment 1 (Oct 29) and memory (Nov 2): $9.99/month, $79.99/year. governance/ACQUISITION-RETENTION-001.md A4 shows "$7.99/month" on the lock screen. docs/CODEX_CAMPAIGN_SYSTEM_SPEC.md (May) and memory /areas/endless-tales-platform.md (Aug) say $7.99/$59.99. DEPLOY.md lists old tiers and credit packs. Recommendation: $9.99/$79.99 wins (newest; also in code, lib/finance/statement.ts). Fix the old docs. Marc decides.
  • C2. [RESOLVED by decision 52, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Trial. Nov 2 (CAC chat) and Amendment 1: 14-day trial, card required. ACQUISITION-RETENTION-001 A3–A4 and the Aug platform memory: 7-day free week, no card. Recommendation: 14 days, card required (newest). Marc decides.
  • C3. [RESOLVED by decision 56, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Meta access. Aug–Oct standing rule: "Meta Ads Manager is Marc-only; no agent has access to Meta" (memory bell-meta-marketing.md; Oct 11 ways-of-working). Amendment 1 (Oct 29): Susan builds paused drafts through the API and Susan/Orion press LAUNCH. Recommendation: Amendment 1 wins: agents touch Meta only through the gated server routes, never by logging into Ads Manager. Marc decides.
  • C4. [RESOLVED by decision 56, Marc Nov 9, 2026] What Meta optimizes for. Amendment 1 §11.3 and the Oct 29 plan: signup (CompleteRegistration). CAC chat (Nov 2) and Susan's Nov 7 paper plan: Trial Start. The question was reopened Nov 1 and never closed. Recommendation: Trial Start, because the CAC goal is built on cost per trial. Marc decides.
  • C5. [RESOLVED by decision 1, Marc Nov 9, 2026] When a hook ad may run. Nov 6: launch as soon as that series' Episodes 2 and 3 are live. Nov 8 and PIPELINE-CANON HOOK-SERIES: all 7 Season 1 episodes publish together. Recommendation: Nov 8 wins: the ad waits until the whole Season 1 is live. Marc decides.
  • C6. [RESOLVED by decision 103, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Brief approval. Oct 27 plan: Marc approves Strategos's brief before Susan starts. Nov 2 handoff: Strategos sends the brief straight to Susan; Marc's only gate is before launch. Recommendation: keep Marc's gate before launch only (rule 1), and add rule 8. Marc decides.
  • C7. [RESOLVED by decision 56, Marc Nov 9, 2026] CAC lines. Nov 2 CAC chat: pass under $40, target $26–31, stop over $60. 6+2 plan: goal under $30, stop blended CAC over $45. Recommendation: the 6+2 numbers win (newer, and in the plan). Marc decides.
  • C8. [RESOLVED by decision 57, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Plow back. Nov 2 pro forma: 75% of revenue goes to marketing; Admin Command Center "Marketing target %" (default 75) is applied to Stripe collections. Nov 8: 75% of the previous month's profit, $0 after a loss month. Recommendation: Nov 8 wins (see CANON-14). Marc decides.
  • C9. [RESOLVED by decision 12, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Test market. ACQUISITION-RETENTION-001 Parts A, D, E: Greenville-local stories, 12 test cells, no Belle before signup. Nov 2026 plan: broad US, ages 30–65, hook series. Recommendation: mark Parts A, D and E of ACQUISITION-RETENTION-001 as history for marketing. Marc decides.
  • C10. [RESOLVED by decision 104, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Where the Meta key lives. Amendment 1 §7.5 says Vercel. The app and agents run on EC2, so Susan could not use the key (Nov 7). Recommendation: update the spec to "server environment on EC2" (rule 26). Marc decides.
  • C11. [RESOLVED by decision 105, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Ad Manager phone preview as approval. Nov 7, Claude offered a one-time Monday launch where Marc builds the Rerouted ad in Ads Manager and Meta's "Preview on phone" counts as approval. That breaks rules 9 and 21. No answer from Marc was found. Recommendation: allow only as a written, one-time override (rule 12). Marc decides.

Open questions for Marc

  • Q1. [RESOLVED by decision 56, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Do you approve Strategos's stop rules (rules 34–39)? They are still marked "awaiting approval." Suggested answer: approve as written.
  • Q2. [RESOLVED by decision 56, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Should Meta optimize for Trial Start or signup? Suggested answer: Trial Start.
  • Q3. [RESOLVED by decision 56, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Which Meta ad account runs Endless Tales ads (WonderBooks Press, your personal one, or a new Endless Tales account)? Suggested answer: a new or renamed Endless Tales account, paid by the ad-spend card.

  • Q6. [RESOLVED by decision 108, Marc Nov 9, 2026] What is influencer/PR outreach for: press, partnerships or paid creators? Suggested answer: decide after the Meta test.
  • Q7. [RESOLVED by decision 109, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Must "Owner tested personally" be ticked before APPROVE works? Suggested answer: yes.
  • Q8. [RESOLVED by decision 110, Marc Nov 9, 2026] Can you override Amendment 1 in a chat message, or only on the card? Suggested answer: only in writing, saved on the card with the date.
